title: AviKndr/universal-words
summary: Answer to Problem 10.32 of the Kourovka Notebook, posed by Yu. I. Merzlyakov in 1986 and still open in the Notebook's 21st edition (2026), in both directions. Positive direction: there are constants C and N0 such that for all nonzero integers r, s with r or s odd, the word x^r y^s is universal on the symmetric group S_n (every permutation is a value) whenever n >= N0 and n >= C * log m(r,s), where m(r,s) is the product of the distinct primes dividing rs. review.reason: Answers an open Kourovka Notebook problem on universal words in symmetric groups.
